headline: Discussed projected budget deficits, proposed spending caps, and a draft fiscal sustainability policy.
summary: Officials reviewed property taxes, state aid, local receipts, and reserve funds for future budgets. Town Manager Austin Cyganiewicz proposed expense caps for outer years, and the school business manager raised concerns about the proposed 3.5% school cap. The group agreed to keep meeting monthly.
decisions: Reduce the solar energy credit revenue projection to zero for the outer years of the financial model; recommended.
Scheduled the next meeting for September 15, 2026 at 8:00 AM and agreed to meet monthly; approved by consensus.

decision_evidence.quote: Mr. Cyganiewicz recommended a reduction of this projection to zero for the outer years of the financial model.

The Group reached consensus to schedule the next meeting for September 15, 2026 at 8:00 AM, and to continue meeting monthly, prioritizing Tuesday and Thursday availability, to prepare for the upcoming budget season.
